title: Runtime call integrity evaluator for model-config regressions (selection + arg validation)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build an automated evaluation harness that detects quality regressions in function/tool selection and argument validation resulting from model or config changes. This harness will run in CI and in nightly regression jobs, provide signal to the Console (regression dashboards/alerts), and block risky rollouts via feature flags. Scope: tool selection accuracy, argument schema conformance, argument sanitization/safety checks, and end-to-end fidelity (selected tool + executed args produce expected effect). Out of scope for this ticket: tool runtime performance benchmarking and non-functional cost metrics (separate tickets).
acceptance_criteria: A runnable CI job that executes the harness against a snapshot of the model + routing config and returns a pass/fail status
Defined oracle dataset (>=1.2k cases) covering deterministic and ambiguous selection scenarios across 10 tool types
Argument validation checks implemented for 8 canonical schemas with >=95% schema-conformance on known-good branch
Regression alerts emitted to the Console when selection accuracy drops >3 percentage points or argument-conformance drops >4 percentage points compared to baseline
Canary gating documented: failures must block model/config rollout to >=Dedicated-tier unless explicitly overridden by SRE/PM
Dashboard shows per-rule and aggregate deltas and stores historical baseline for 30 days
success_metrics: False positive rate for blocking CI job <= 2% (operational tolerance)
Mean time to detect regression in nightly run <= 4 hours
Percent of regressions triaged within 48 hours >= 90%
datasets: arg-schema-snippets-v2 (synthetic + extracted production examples, ~3k unique arg patterns)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (dev): local harness and small synthetic dataset run by ENG team
Phase 2 (staging): CI job added to model/config change pipeline with WARNING signal and dashboarding
Phase 3 (canary): enable blocking for 10% of Dedicated rollouts and require manual override for failures
Phase 4 (prod): blocking enabled for all eligible rollouts and integrated into release playbook
dependencies: ENG-174002 - stable oracle dataset creation (labeling backlog)
ENG-168900 - standardized argument schema registry API
SEC-2102 - security-review for argument sanitizer and secret redaction
